response.title: which solar generator for home backup can run the essentials the longest during an outage
response.answer:
For home backup during a power outage, the solar generator that runs your essentials the longest is generally the one with the largest expandable battery capacity—not necessarily the highest wattage or biggest solar panels.

My top choices would be EcoFlow DELTA Pro Ultra, Anker SOLIX F3800, and Bluetti Apex 300. All three are designed for more serious home backup than a typical portable power station.

The key is to compare three things:

Battery capacity (kWh): Determines how many hours or days your essentials can run.

Solar charging (W): Determines how quickly you can replenish energy during daylight.

Expandable capacity: Determines whether you can grow from a one-day backup system to several days or potentially longer.

For refrigerators, internet, lights, fans, and other essentials, I'd prioritize capacity and energy efficiency over maximum AC output.

For outages lasting several days, solar panels can make a bigger difference than simply adding batteries. For example, 1,000W of panels producing 3 effective sun-hours per day, at 80% net charging efficiency, could replenish about 2.4 kWh daily. That could cover a 100W average load, but not a 300W average load indefinitely.

My recommendation: Start by evaluating the EcoFlow DELTA Pro Ultra with 12–18 kWh of storage and enough solar panels to replenish your daily essential consumption. For hardwired household circuits, plan on a professionally installed transfer switch or compatible home backup panel.
